environment.title: Environment in {{name}}
environment.subtitle: Manage the contract environment of a chain. Deploy a Create2Token, a FungibleFactory, and a FungibleEnvironment, then assign them to the chain.
environment.fungibleFactoryDesc: Deploy a FungibleFactory contract on this chain, then set it into the environment. The factory gates creation of new Fungible Standard Tokens on this chain.
environment.fungibleEnvironmentDesc: Deploy a FungibleEnvironment contract on this chain to manage payment tokens and price feeds for the token ecosystem.

tokenPerimeter.title: Token Perimeter
tokenPerimeter.subtitle: Manage the EVM chains covered by the multichain token. Bind new chains to add them to the token perimeter or unbind existing ones to remove them.
tokenPerimeter.unbindWarning: Warning: This action cannot be undone
tokenPerimeter.unbindDescription: Unbinding {{name}} will remove the token on this chain from the multichain token perimeter. Tokens already bridged to this chain will not be burned.
tokenPerimeter.successBound: Successfully bound {{name}} to the multichain token perimeter
tokenPerimeter.errorBindFailed: Failed to bind chain. Please try again.
tokenPerimeter.successUnbound: Successfully unbound {{name}} from the multichain token perimeter
tokenPerimeter.errorUnbindFailed: Failed to unbind chain. Please try again.

tokenBridge.title: Token Bridge
tokenBridge.subtitle: Bridge tokens between chains in the multichain token perimeter
tokenBridge.noTransactionsDesc: Your bridge history will appear here
tokenBridge.masterToSlaveDesc: Bridge from Master Token (Ethereum) to Slave Tokens on other chains
tokenBridge.slaveToMasterDesc: Bridge from Slave Tokens back to Master Token on Ethereum
tokenBridge.oneToOneRatioDesc: Tokens are bridged at a 1:1 ratio with no fees (gas fees apply)
